rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for giving food to a person or animal, including giving one thing to another as food.

example.english: I feed my dog every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wai3 gau2 gau2 sik6 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for food given to animals.

example.english: This feed for the cows needs some corn added to it to be nutritious.
example.traditional: 呢啲牛食嘅飼料要加啲粟米先夠營養。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 ngau4 sik6 ge3 zi6 liu2 jiu3 gaa1 di1 suk1 mai5 sin1 gau3 jing4 joeng5

rows.note: Use this for a satellite or broadcast feed understood as an electronic signal.

example.english: The satellite feed received by the TV station keeps cutting out, so the livestream often stops.
example.traditional: 電視台收到嘅衛星訊號斷斷續續，個直播成日停。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 sau1 dou2 ge3 wai6 sing1 seon3 hou6 dyun6 dyun6 zuk6 zuk6 go3 zik6 bo3 seng4 jat6 ting4

rows.note: Use this for a general ongoing supply, rather than a broadcast or data signal.

example.english: This farm has a continuous feed of fresh water.
example.traditional: 呢個農場長期供應新鮮食水。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 nung4 coeng4 coeng4 kei4 gung1 jing3 san1 sin1 sik6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when the subject, usually an animal, is eating or grazing rather than being given food.

example.english: This cow can feed on grass.
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 ngau4 ho2 ji5 sik6 cou2

rows.note: Use this technical noun for the machine part that feeds paper or other material into a process.

example.english: The feed in the printing machine is jammed, so the paper cannot go in.
example.traditional: 部印刷機嘅送料器卡住咗，張紙入唔到去。
example.jyutping: bou6 jan3 caat3 gei1 ge3 sung3 liu6 hei3 kaa1 zyu6 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 jap6 m4 dou2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when a source supplies something such as water to a place or system.

example.english: This reservoir helps feed the whole district with drinking water.
example.traditional: 呢個水庫供應成個區嘅食水。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seoi2 fu3 gung1 jing3 seng4 go3 keoi1 ge3 sik6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this in machine or computer contexts for putting physical material or data into a system to be processed.

example.english: We need to feed the data into the system before we can analyse it.
example.traditional: 我哋要將資料餵入個系統，先至可以分析。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 zi1 liu2 wai3 jap6 go3 hai6 tung2 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 fan1 sik1
